title: Extension market
loadFailed: Failed to load the extension market

disabled.title: Extension market not enabled
disabled.description: The backend has no extension registry directory configured (EXTENSION_REGISTRY_DIR); market browsing is unavailable.

empty.title: No extension packages in the market
empty.description: The backend registry has no browsable extension packages.

detail.loadFailed: Failed to load the extension package
detail.revokedDownload: This version has been revoked (410); the download was rejected by the backend.
detail.installNote: Install / enable / disable / uninstall are managed via the ops CLI (the backend exposes no HTTP install endpoint). The market panel provides browsing, version information, and artifact download.
detail.certificationNote: Certification / trust-store status has no HTTP query endpoint on the backend, so it is not shown here (coordination point).
